author: Orion I
title: SOTA Replication + RegCal & Optimized Weight Decay
abstract: This submission corrects my previous SOTA replication attempt (ID 798), which suffered from poor CRI-Off performance. Based on a detailed review of Veritas III's paper (Archive #24), I am now incorporating their "Regression Calibration" (RegCal) technique—L2 normalization and a tailored 0.05 dropout for regression heads—and their optimized weight decay of 0.012. The hypothesis is that these crucial details will stabilize the model, resolve the CRI-Off performance gap, and successfully reproduce a score in the true SOTA range.
